part.text:
Fixed. The change in gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java:495 makes `value(double)` respect lenient mode, matching `value(Number)` behavior — NaN/infinite values are only rejected when not lenient, and in lenient mode they're written as `NaN`/`Infinity`/`-Infinity` via `Double.toString`.

Verification: `JsonWriterTest` (39 tests), `JsonReaderTest` (120 tests), and `JsonTokenTest` all pass, including the lenient double-value cases.
